issue.title: Upgrade the docs toolchain from Zensical 0.0.71 to the 0.1.x line
issue.description:
Source: bob-cli-a0.13 handoff item 5 (file:explicit:c447d1a8eb7915f61a1b165d, full copy at research:202610/bob_public_docs_site/bob_public_docs_site__handoff.md), filed by bob-cli-a0.land.

The docs toolchain pins `zensical==0.0.71` in tools/docs/pyproject.toml, and the live https://bobs-org.github.io/build.json reports zensical 0.0.71. The approved docs-site plan (plan:202610/bob_public_docs_site.md) expected a move to the dependable 0.1.x line, which per the plan's research begins 2026-11-05.

Steps (do not start before a 0.1.x release exists on PyPI):
1. Check the locked version: `uv run --project tools/docs zensical --version`.
2. Upgrade: change the pin in tools/docs/pyproject.toml to the 0.1.x release, then run `uv lock --project tools/docs --upgrade-package zensical`.
3. Run `just docs-check` (strict Zensical build, lint, links, search smoke, tutorial, unit tests), `just docs-build-material`, and `just docs-a11y`.
4. Review MiniJinja template compatibility in docs/overrides (main.html, partials/*), and confirm the bob-task fence, contract banner, provenance footer, component chips, and llms.txt still render.
5. Update the version mentions in docs/develop/build.md and tools/docs/README.md if they name 0.0.71.

task_type_fields.proposal: Bump tools/docs from zensical==0.0.71 to the dependable 0.1.x line once it is released, and re-verify both builders, templates, a11y, and llms.txt.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The release does not exist yet (expected 2026-11-05). The bob-cli-a0 epic shipped on 0.0.71 by design and is closing now.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-a0 polish handoff left the Zensical 0.1.x bump as a dated watch item. A task makes it actionable once 0.1.x ships (expected 2026-11-05), instead of leaving it only in a research note.
